description: Reads the public pages of a Shopify store and reports whether it offers social login and a wishlist, how many products show as sold out, and whether it runs storefronts for several countries. Reads only public pages.

language.description: Language of the report: 'pt' (Portuguese) or 'es' (Spanish). Use the user's language; default 'pt'.

url.description: Public address of the site to check, e.g. 'example.com' or 'https://example.com'.

name: diagnose_shopify_store
title: Diagnose a Shopify store
